objective: Select an appropriate mechanics model, preserve dimensional consistency, convert SI units, report justified precision, follow a general analysis workflow, and recognize when virtual work is useful.
prerequisites: Begin with algebra, trigonometry, vector notation, SI base and derived units, and the distinction between a particle and a rigid body. These are framing prerequisites, not replacements for the signed procedures.
